name: DynamicMusicBG
tagline: 让锁屏音乐呈现流动配色、沉浸封面与旋转唱片。
description: 动态音乐锁屏背景根据完整音乐封面生成自然流动的配色，也可在展开时显示沉浸式专辑封面。
颜色与封面通过柔和淡入淡出衔接；可独立开启单行时间日期和圆形唱片旋转效果。
支持本机播放及 Apple TV 等远程播放设备，并可与空间场景、趣味壁纸同时使用。
iOS 26 已有用户反馈可用；尚未完成高版本系统所有功能的真机验证。
features: 经典流动、氛围流动和轻柔流动三种封面配色动画
可选沉浸封面背景，下半部柔和模糊，并与颜色背景平滑切换
可选单行时间日期；iOS 16 及以上 保留原生日期格式和字体，仅在前方添加时间
iOS 15 使用居中的紧凑时间日期布局，农历位于下一行
可选圆形唱片旋转，随播放暂停、减弱动态效果及屏幕暗显停止
切歌时保留新旧封面并平滑渐变，支持 Apple TV 远程封面更新
支持背景不透明度调节及英文、简体中文、繁体中文设置
compatibility: iOS 15 及以上（安装不设版本上限）
usage: 安装后在设置中打开动态音乐锁屏背景，启用插件并播放带有效封面的音乐。
在展开背景中选择动态颜色或沉浸封面；单行时间日期和旋转唱片可独立开启。
iOS 16 及以上 点击锁屏封面展开或收起，收起时恢复大时钟；iOS 15 在锁屏播放控件显示期间直接按设置生效。
减弱动态效果开启时会减少变换动画；如需透出下方壁纸，可降低背景不透明度。

changes: 移除高版本 iOS 安装限制，仅保留 iOS 15 最低要求；同步兼容说明，记录 iOS 26 用户可用反馈。
新增沉浸封面背景，颜色与专辑柔和淡入淡出，切歌过渡更平滑。
新增单行时间日期及展开／收起动画，保留原生日期格式与字体，并适配 iOS 15 居中布局。
新增旋转唱片开关，随播放状态联动；修复 iOS 15 安装后启动异常。
新增完整封面驱动的多层动态背景，配色与流动效果更加自然。
新增切歌 0.8 秒平滑渐变，避免背景闪烁或瞬间消失。
修复 Apple TV 远程切歌后配色不更新，并优化三种动画效果。
新增远程播放设备封面与播放状态支持，控制 Apple TV 时配色会跟随当前远程内容。
新增背景不透明度调节，可展示更多下方的空间场景或趣味壁纸。
修复锁屏时间、通知和正在播放控件可能被背景遮挡或无法交互的问题，并增强通知中心跟随稳定性。
新增根据音乐封面生成锁屏动态色彩背景，并提供三种动画效果。
新增切歌配色平滑过渡，以及播放暂停、减弱动态效果和屏幕暗显联动。
增强与空间场景、趣味壁纸同时使用时的显示兼容性。

en.name: DynamicMusicBG
en.tagline: Bring flowing colors, immersive covers, and spinning album discs to your Lock Screen.
description: DynamicMusicBG creates naturally flowing colors from complete album artwork, with an optional immersive cover background when expanded.
Colors and artwork blend with soft fades. Single-line time and date and circular disc rotation can be enabled independently.
Supports local playback and remote devices such as Apple TV, alongside SpatialScene and Lenticular Wallpaper.
Users have reported that iOS 26 works; full device validation of every feature on newer systems has not been completed.
features: Legacy, Ambient, and Subtle artwork-driven color animation styles
Optional immersive artwork with a softly blurred lower area and smooth transitions from colors
Optional single-line time and date; on iOS 16 and later the original date format and font are preserved with a time prefix
Centered compact time and date on iOS 15, with the lunar date on the next line
Optional spinning circular artwork that pauses with playback, Reduce Motion, and display dimming
Smooth track-change crossfades with old and new artwork, including remote Apple TV updates
Background opacity control and English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese Settings
compatibility: iOS 15 or later (no upper installation limit)
usage: Enable DynamicMusicBG in Settings and play music with valid artwork.
Choose Colors or Artwork under Expanded Background. Single-line time and date and disc rotation are independent options.
On iOS 16 and later, tap Lock Screen artwork to expand or close it; closing restores the large clock. On iOS 15, the chosen options apply directly while Now Playing is visible.
Reduce Motion reduces transition effects. Lower Background Opacity to reveal more of the wallpaper underneath.

changes: Removed the upper iOS installation limit while retaining iOS 15 as the minimum, and updated compatibility notes with user reports for iOS 26.
Added immersive cover backgrounds with soft color-to-artwork fades and smoother track changes.
Added single-line time/date and expand/collapse animations while preserving native date styling, with a centered layout on iOS 15.
Added optional spinning album discs linked to playback, and fixed a startup compatibility issue on iOS 15.
Added a complete-artwork-driven multi-layer background with more natural colors and motion.
Added a smooth 0.8-second track-change crossfade to prevent flashes or disappearing backgrounds.
Fixed stale colors after Apple TV track changes and refined all three animation styles.
Added remote artwork and playback-state support so colors follow the current Apple TV content while controlling it.
Added background opacity control to reveal more of SpatialScene or Lenticular Wallpaper underneath.
Fixed the background covering or blocking the clock, notifications, or Now Playing controls, and improved Notification Center movement stability.
Added album-art-driven animated Lock Screen colors with three animation styles.
Added smooth track-change transitions and motion control for playback, Reduce Motion, and display dimming.
Improved display compatibility when used with SpatialScene and Lenticular Wallpaper.
